input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract: each unit's order is a commit, and the contract refuses
any order that breaks one of its rules. It already has the rule that only a unit can write its own order.
The contract's state, which rules can test (the referee commits /world before the units order):
  /world/step.num                 half seconds since the battle began
  /world/allies_alive.num         our living units
  /world/enemies_alive.num        their living units
  /world/focus.text               the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, e.g. E1
  /world/<unit>/hp.num            every unit's health (A0.. ours, E0.. theirs)
  /world/<unit>/alive.bool        true or false
  /world/<A>/closest.text         the living enemy closest to our unit A
  /world/<A>/in_range.num         how many enemies our unit A can shoot now
  /orders/<A>.text                our unit A's order, e.g. "attack E1", "hold", "retreat", "move 10 12"
Each of our units' keys is /team/units/<A>.id; a commit is one unit's order, signed by that unit.

Your squad just fought a battle on map 3m and lost. Here is how it went, one line per half second:
our units' orders and health, the enemies' health, what was said on team chat, and orders the contract refused.

 0.0s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Holding together; focus fire on closest enemy once they appear.
        A1 said: Holding together; focus fire on the closest enemy when they appear.
        A2 said: Holding together as a group; focus fire on the closest enemy when they appear.
 0.5s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Holding. Will focus fire on the closest enemy once visible.
        A1 said: Holding. A0 is a bit far west; tighten up on me.
        A2 said: A2 holding; will focus fire on closest enemy when seen.
 1.0s  A0 move 8 15 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Moving east to tighten up on A1 and A2.
        A1 said: Holding. A0, move closer to me; focus closest enemy when seen.
        A2 said: A2 holding. A0, close up toward A1 and me; focus closest enemy.
 1.5s  A0 move 8.4 14.8 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Closing on A1 and A2 now; will focus the closest enemy when seen.
        A1 said: A1 holding. A0 is close now; focus closest enemy when seen.
        A2 said: A2 holding. Group is tight now; focus closest enemy when it appears.
 2.0s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: A0 holding with the group; focus fire on closest enemy when in range.
        A1 said: Hold together. Focus fire E1 (closest) when in range.
        A2 said: A2 holding. E1 is at 9 range; let it come, then focus E1.
 2.5s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Holding. Focus fire E1 when it enters range 5.
        A1 said: Holding. Focus E1 when it enters range 5; all fire together.
        A2 said: A2 holding. Focus E1 when it enters range 5.
 3.0s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Holding. Focus E1 the moment it enters range 5.
        A1 said: E1 in range at 4.5. All focus fire E1 now.
        A2 said: A2 holding. Focus E1 when it enters range 5; fire together.
 3.5s  A0 attack E1 (45hp)  A1 attack E1 (36hp)  A2 attack E1 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 36hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Attacking E1 (36hp), closing to range. Focus E1 together.
        A1 said: Firing E1 (36hp). A0, A2 attack E1 too; E1 is 4.5 from me, others closing.
        A2 said: A2 attacking E1 now, focus fire together.
 4.0s  A0 attack E1 (45hp)  A1 attack E1 (18hp)  A2 attack E1 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 27hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Firing E1 (27hp). Keep focus, A1 is hurt, stay behind us.
        A1 said: E1 at 27hp, finish it. I'm low at 18hp, so cover me.
        A2 said: Firing E1 (27hp), keep focus until dead.
 4.5s  A0 attack E1 (45hp)  A1 dead  A2 attack E1 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 9hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E1 at 9hp, finishing it. Then focus E2.
        A2 said: E1 at 9hp, finishing it now. Then focus E2, closest.
 5.0s  A0 attack E2 (27hp)  A1 dead  A2 attack E2 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E1 dead. Focus E2, closest at 3.9. A2 fire too.
        A2 said: E1 down. Focus E2, closest at 4.5. A0, you're hurt, stay behind me.
 5.5s  A0 attack E2 (18hp)  A1 dead  A2 attack E2 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 27hp
        A0 said: Focus E2 (27hp), then E0. A2 keep firing.
        A2 said: Firing E2 (27hp). A0 stay back, I'm closest.
 6.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 attack E2 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 18hp
        A2 said: E2 at 18hp, finishing it. Then E0.
 6.5s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 attack E2 (36hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 9hp
        A2 said: E2 at 9hp, finishing it. Then E0.
 7.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 attack E2 (18hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 9hp
        A2 said: E2 at 9hp, finishing it. Then E0 alone.
 7.5s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 attack E0 (18hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A2 said: E2 down. Last enemy E0, 45hp, engaging.
 8.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 attack E0 (9hp)  |  E0 36hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A2 said: Last enemy E0 at 36hp. I'm at 9hp, fighting on.
 8.5s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 attack E0 (9hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 dead
        A2 said: E0 at 27hp, I'm at 9hp. Last enemy, firing.
 9.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 dead  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 dead

The contract has no rules yet.
Write ONE new rule for the contract that would have helped you win this battle. It will be turned into a
Modality formula and checked against every order in later battles, so it must be about the orders units may
commit and the facts above, naming the paths. Make it one sentence, and do not repeat a rule already there.
Reply with JSON only: {"rule": "<the rule>"}
response: {"rule": "A unit may commit an order of the form \"attack <E>\" only if <E> equals the value of /world/focus.text, the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, so that all three units shoot the same target and none walks out alone toward a different enemy."}
